# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| <2.6.1  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately via a Security Advisory: https://github.com/Lolka-App/lolka.pycord/security/advisories/new
